text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well then boss, I'm heading out early~ 
Thanks for the hard work~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm just a shopper from here on 
out! I seriously want those cosmetics that 
came in today—

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ah, were you eyeing that one?! The 
customer before you just grabbed the very 
last one~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahn!? No way, seriously!? That was my 
whole motivation to keep working hard, 
though~~!?

Unable to get the cosmetics she wanted, 
she ended up feeling down in the dumps...
